newsitem.title: UK: Cathay begins HK/Chicago freight service.
newsitem.headline: Cathay begins HK/Chicago freight service.

text.p: Cathay Pacific Cargo 0293.HK. has restarted freighter operations from Hong Kong to Chicago the company said in a statement.
Cathay Pacific briefly yielded the Chicago operation nearly a year ago to subsidiary Air Hong Kong, but has resumed the route with a view to further developing the American market.
Hong Kong and the United States signed an air services agreement in April which allows Cathay Pacific to operate freighter services to six U.S. airports.
The Chicago service will use Boeing 747-400 freighter aircraft and will operate four times a week. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
